newsitem.title: USA: GPU sees full power restoration Thursday.
newsitem.headline: GPU sees full power restoration Thursday.

text.p: GPU Inc said on Wednesday that it expects power to be fully restored in northwestern New Jersey by midday Thursday and the majority of customers will have electricity by late tonight, after Monday's storms.
As of 1700 EST, service had been restored to more than 58,000 customers. Overall, more than 75,000 customers were affected by the spring storm, GPU said.
Today's restoration was assisted with the addition of numerous crews from neighboring utilities, GPU said.
Repair crews are working in Sussex, Warren and western Morris counties, which sustained the most damage, GPU said.
